name_reason: Descriptor '_2bpp' is a factual misnomer: the font sheet is 1bpp, not 2bpp. The glyph stride is 0x20 bytes for a 16-row glyph (disasm 0x4eaa0 SHL EAX,0x5 = idx*0x20), i.e. 2 bytes/row = 16 bits over 16 columns = exactly 1 bit per pixel. Each row is read as one byte-swapped ushort (LODSW + XCHG AH,AL at 0x4eac2/0x4eac4) and consumed MSB-first one bit per column (SHL AX,1; JNC at 0x4eac9). The src comment (blitspr.c lines 1149-1152) and the Ghidra plate both already state the sheet is 1bpp and call '2bpp' a misnomer; the name was kept only to stay byte-identical with the live symbol and routing table. Proposed: fd2_blit_glyph_1bpp_with_outline. Recorded only; rename applies in Stage 2 (touches protos.h/types.h/routing.json/dialog.c + 2 call sites in fd2_display_dialog_scene + 6 KB docs).
purpose: Per-glyph dialog text renderer: draws a 16x16 monochrome (1bpp) glyph from a font sheet into a destination buffer, with an optional solid background fill and a 1-pixel L-shaped drop shadow.
logic_summary: Spills all 7 cdecl args into the shared global render-state struct data_fd2_graphics_glyph_blit_state (0x627A3), then re-reads them from the struct (mirrors the binary's spill/reload). pitch is taken as 16-bit (XOR EBP,EBP; MOV BP,[0x627A3]). Step 1: if bg_color != 0, fill a 16x16 box at dst_buf (16 rows x 4 dword writes = 16 bytes/row) with the bg byte replicated to a dword (bg_color*0x01010101), advancing by pitch each row. Step 2: if glyph_idx != 10 (the space glyph; paints nothing but bg fill still runs), set glyph_row = font_data + glyph_idx*0x20 and loop 16 rows: read the row's two bytes as a byte-swapped ushort (first stream byte = left 8 pixels), then for 16 columns test the MSB (sign bit) and shift left; for each set bit write fill_color at the pixel, outline_color at pixel+pitch-1 (shadow below-left) and pixel+pitch (shadow directly below). dst advances by 1 per column, by pitch per row; glyph_row advances by 2 per row. Body wrapped in PUSHAD/POPAD, EAX untouched -> the decompiler 'return in_EAX' is a passthrough artifact; both call sites discard it, so effectively void.
signature: void fd2_blit_glyph_2bpp_with_outline(uint32 font_data, uint32 glyph_idx, uint32 dst_buf, uint32 pitch, uint32 fill_color, uint32 outline_color, uint16 bg_color)

params.name: font_data
params.semantics: 1bpp font sheet base linear address (0x20 bytes per glyph). Caller passes _data_fd2_chinese_font_sheet (FDOTHER[4]).
params.reason: Accurately names the font sheet base; no address residue.

params.name: glyph_idx
params.semantics: Index of the glyph within the font sheet. 10 = space (paints nothing, but a non-zero bg still fills). Caller passes the raw text opcode for text, or digit_buf[i]-0x30 for literal-number digits.
params.reason: Correct semantic name; no address residue. '10' is a domain whitespace sentinel, not part of the name.

params.name: dst_buf
params.semantics: Destination base linear address (the current render position pRender_pos; typically the mode13h framebuffer 0xA0000-based).

params.name: pitch
params.semantics: Destination row stride in bytes; only the low 16 bits are used (XOR EBP,EBP; MOV BP,[0x627A3]). Caller passes render_pitch (typically 0x140 = 320). Also doubles as the drop-shadow vertical offset (pitch and pitch-1).
params.reason: Correct; no address residue. Declared uint32 because the cdecl stack slot is a full dword; body uses the low 16 bits (type unchanged per workflow rules).

params.name: fill_color
params.semantics: Palette index written for each 'on' glyph-body pixel (low byte used, MOV [0x627A5],AL).
params.reason: Correct; no address residue. Full-dword stack slot, low byte used.

params.name: outline_color
params.semantics: Palette index for the 1-pixel drop shadow written below-left and directly below each on pixel (low byte used, MOV [0x627A7],AL).
params.reason: Correct; no address residue. Full-dword stack slot, low byte used.

params.name: bg_color
params.semantics: Background fill color applied to the whole 16x16 box before glyph rendering; 0 = skip the bg fill entirely (low byte used, MOV [0x627A6],AL).
params.reason: Correct; no address residue. 0-skip is documented semantics, not part of the name.

returns.semantics: No meaningful return. The binary preserves entry EAX via PUSHAD/POPAD; the decompiler's 'return in_EAX' is a passthrough artifact and both call sites discard it. Declared void in src.

reads_globals: data_fd2_graphics_glyph_blit_state (0x627A3; re-reads pFont_data/nGlyph_idx/pDst_buf/wPitch/bFill_color/bOutline_color/bBg_color after spilling args into it)
writes_globals: data_fd2_graphics_glyph_blit_state (0x627A3; spills all 7 args into the struct fields at entry: pFont_data 0x627AC, nGlyph_idx 0x627B0, pDst_buf 0x627A8, wPitch 0x627A3, bFill_color 0x627A5, bOutline_color 0x627A7, bBg_color 0x627A6)
notes: Disassembly (0x4ea2a) fully confirms the src signature stack-slot mapping: [EBP+8]=font_data->0x627AC, [EBP+C]=glyph_idx->0x627B0, [EBP+10]=dst_buf->0x627A8, [EBP+14] AX=pitch->0x627A3, [EBP+18] AL=fill_color->0x627A5, [EBP+1C] AL=outline_color->0x627A7, [EBP+20] AL=bg_color->0x627A6. Ghidra's own decompile shows a confusing slot-shuffle (font_data slot holds pitch etc.) which the src has already correctly resolved. Source comment block (lines 1146-1204) is accurate and refined (documents the 1bpp misnomer, the spill/reload, the PUSHAD/POPAD EAX passthrough, the cdecl ABI, and all 7 args) -> kept verbatim, no Edit. Ghidra plate also states the sheet is 1bpp and is consistent with the refined understanding -> no plate change. Only change recorded is the name rename proposal (2bpp -> 1bpp), to be applied in Stage 2. No logic touched.
